mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRAVEL_PLAN ( PLAN_ID, OWNER_MEMBER_ID, TITLE, REGION_CODE, START_DATE, END_DATE, VISIBILITY ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{title}, #{regionCode}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{visibility} )
mapper.select: SELECT P.PLAN_ID, P.TITLE, P.REGION_CODE, R.REGION_NAME, P.START_DATE, P.END_DATE, P.VISIBILITY, P.VERSION_NO FROM TRAVEL_PLAN P JOIN REGION_MASTER R ON R.REGION_CODE = P.REGION_CODE WHERE P.PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
